title: Trader Diary: The $80k Dip
content:
Saw BTC slide to $80,506 and my brain went from "HODL" to "SHORT NOW!" in 3 seconds.
Now I'm glued to 1‑minute candles like it's the season finale of my favorite drama.
lesson: Set your stop‑loss before the FOMO hits – a 3% dip isn’t a signal to double‑down.
question: Who else turned their coffee into a stress test today? Show us your 1‑min chart screenshots 👇
